description: This file contains utility functions related to week calculations within the date library. It includes functions to determine the week number, the year for a given week, and the number of weeks in a year, based on the ISO week-date standard.

methods.name: firstWeekOffset(year, dow, doy)
methods.description: Calculates the offset for the first week of the year based on the starting day of week and day of year conventions.

methods.name: dayOfYearFromWeeks(year, week, weekday, dow, doy)
methods.description: Given a year, week number, and weekday, computes the exact day of year and corresponding year, considering year boundaries.

methods.name: weekOfYear(mom, dow, doy)
methods.description: Determines the week number and corresponding year for a given moment object, considering the locale's week start day.

methods.name: weeksInYear(year, dow, doy)
methods.description: Calculates the total number of weeks in a given year, based on week conventions.
